input.summary: Re-add cgi module to standard library for lightweight scripts

decision.title: Remove CGI and related dead-battery modules (PEP 594)
decision.summary: Deprecate and remove cgi and other unmaintained standard library modules following PEP 594.
decision.sourceTitle: PEP 594: Removing dead batteries from the standard library

items.reason: Direct conflict with accepted PEP 594 decision removing the unmaintained CGI module.

evidence.quote: The cgi module has security liabilities and modern web frameworks have replaced it.
evidence.author: brettcannon

items.rejectedBecause: Security liabilities and availability of modern external alternatives.

conditions.text: Requires modern multipart parsing outside the standard library

health.details: Modern alternative multipart parser package widely available on PyPI
health.interpretation: Constraint holds; ecosystem has transitioned to external packages.

items.reconsiderIf: External multipart parsing packages are no longer maintained or standard library maintenance model changes.

note: Decision support analysis based on historical repository decisions and verified evidence.
